record.title: Recover a coherent synthetic entitlement fixture contract
record.intent: Derive the identity, key, token and private-store inputs needed to test the unchanged ordinary installer offline.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before execution. Use preserved specimen bytes only; no physical contact or source artifact modification.

Recover stock DNA-to-key derivation, identity initialization, Key.data and ordinary option token validation sufficiently to define internally consistent synthetic inputs. Do not combine arbitrary DNA with unexplained unit-specific key state.

Recover the minimum private-store construction and persistence contract, including MemFile serialization and FRAM write requests. Distinguish an explicit synthetic backing store from acquired physical contents.

Select one non-bundle, non-built-in ordinary option and define empty/before, malformed negative, accepted after, process-restart and guest-reboot witnesses. Do not replace validation or option-query results.

Record exact ABIs and byte guards for stock calls or modeled boundaries. Keep unit identifiers and keys private. Close with a reproducible candidate fixture or exact remaining offline/bench gaps; no guest installation in this recovery task.
acceptance: A coherent synthetic fixture and validation protocol are specified from stock evidence
or exact blockers delimit the next branch.
